cells.gaps: Standing rests on a March 2023 communication to the Council of Ministers on the Djibouti Smart Nation roadmap for the digital economy (DJI-002), which records no adoption or approval. DJI-001 (7 Oct 2025) disagrees to the extent that it lists the elaboration of a national digital strategy as a challenge still open; both leave the country with no adopted strategy. No text, period, delivery plan, reporting or governance row has been found, and nothing dated inside the twelve months records a step forward.
cells.note: A national roadmap presented to the Council of Ministers with no adoption recorded is announced, which is stage 2; that rules out stage 1. Stage 3 needs an adoption and a public text, and neither is held.
